kind: # Dated basis rows for the compile-clean leg's cost drift comparator
# (gunbc_ci_compile_clean_clamp_note; shares the witness_row_cost model: same 6-col
# schema, same parser, same srv_fleet_arm64 host-class refusal, same zero-basis
# refusal, same verdict authority witness_row_cost_verdict — the seed reads the arm
# the authority names rather than rebuilding the arms itself).
# The clock column names WHICH clock wall_ms_basis was read from. A row seeded from a
# receipt on a different clock than the observation refuses (BasisClockMismatch) rather
# than answering — the 2026-08-05 clock-basis ruling. It is REQUIRED, not defaulted: an
# unstated clock is exactly the state that made a CPU-vs-wall comparison look correct.
# Keys are (kind, subject): the pass row is (pass, whole_tree) — scoped passes are
# diff-denominated and stay BasisAbsent by design; module rows are
# (module_typecheck, <module path>).
# UNSEEDED ON PURPOSE (the #7475 discipline): rows may only cite an arm64 srv-fleet
# run's OWN receipt rows, and no fleet run has produced them yet — run 30602520347's
# walls predate this receipt and its per-module lines were rounded render text, not
# receipt rows. Until seeded, every row counts BasisAbsent — loud, never read as
# no-drift.
# SEEDING SOURCE, CORRECTED: download the run's floor-receipts artifact and read
# target/floor-compile-clean-cost-receipt.tsv (pass + module_typecheck rows); the
# BasisAbsent count is the [receipt] floor compile-clean cost drift summary line, and
# the full per-row detail is floor-compile-clean-cost-drift-receipt.tsv in the same
# artifact. These lines previously said to scrape [compile-clean-cost] and
# [compile-clean-cost-drift] log lines. Those tags have ZERO emit sites now — the
# receipt bodies were mirrored to stderr only because the files had no way off the
# runner, and gunbc.ci_workflow ci_floor_receipts_upload_step gave them one. An
# operator following the old instruction would grep a log and find nothing, so this
# is corrected rather than left as a second seeding authority beside
# gunbc.ci_spec gunbc_ci_compile_clean_clamp_note (DESIGN section 3).
